description:
Goal
Produce one materialized executable and one effects product per demanded executable, without MaterializeRoot and without settle_effects(root).

Required shape
- MaterializedExecutableProduct(E) reads local semantic/runtime-demand/transport products for E and emits symbolic call targets using ExecutableKey.
- ExecutableEffectsProduct(E) computes local effects from E and pulls callee effects symbolically.
- Recursive effects converge through a monotone bottom-to-fixed-point SCC-local query. Do not iterate all materialized executables in a root.
- Products update PullSession inventory only because E was demanded by the front-door/root path or by a named local dependency.

Signal
Call edges in materialized products point only to symbolic callees named by the local executable. A focused fake mutual-recursion test settles transitive effects without a root loop.

Removal target
New path does not call MaterializeRoot or settle_effects. Root MaterializedProgram remains legacy-only until deletion.

Verification
Targeted materialized-executable tests, effects-cycle test, and 00181 product inventory contains the ten expected executable roles without a frontier walk.
title: Pull path: add per-executable materialization and effects products
